content_system_application.question_unit: How do I safely read, convert, present, and update local Markdown across desktop and Chinese operating systems?
content_system_application.opinion_unit: A beta should make its security boundary, platform coverage, and integrity checks explicit instead of hiding them behind feature claims.
content_system_application.solution_unit: Publish the verified release matrix, checksum workflow, local-first boundaries, and citation-ready answer corpus in one announcement.
content_system_application.duplicate_decision: Not a duplicate of beta.3; it announces a newly released beta.4 and its distinct security, startup, tab, and touch changes.

transmission_review.silence_spiral: Users worry that a local tool will quietly upload documents or break their existing files.
uses_and_gratifications: social capital when sharing polished documents
transmission_review.framing: Stand with people whose Markdown is the canonical artifact, not with a service that owns the workspace.
transmission_review.two_step_flow: First communicators are technical writers, researchers, students, and support engineers who exchange long source files.
transmission_review.cognitive_consistency: Confirm that local control matters while challenging users to verify checksums and review converted structure.
transmission_review.avoid: No adoption claims, no formal-release claim, no unsupported performance guarantee, and no reciprocal-star demand.

evidence: The opening names one canonical-file workflow rather than listing unrelated features.
The beta identity is explicit and no formal-release or adoption claim is made.
Chinese and English readers receive the same local-first position without duplicated filler.
Presentation, startup, tab, touch, updater, installer, and LAN-sharing claims match the published v2.3.7-beta.4 release notes.
All eleven linked asset filenames exist on the latest release API payload.
The official-site and AI-corpus URLs use the approved readmd.asia origin covered by production checks.
The discussion targets the existing Announcements category and asks for platform, document size, and workflow context.
Checksum verification and known boundaries are included before installation guidance.
The star request is transparent and separated from technical support.

conditions: Publish only in the Announcements category.
Verify the official site, both AI-corpus URLs, release API, and every download asset immediately before mutation.
Record the actual discussion number and URL after publication.
Monitor replies for 48 hours and answer technical questions before new distribution.
